en: I am a software engineer focused on distributed storage, systems infrastructure, and high-performance data paths.
zh: 我是一名软件工程师，专注于分布式存储、系统基础设施和高性能数据路径。

en: My work is centered around distributed storage and infrastructure: metadata and data paths, caching, consistency, failure recovery, RPC, Linux I/O, networking, and performance engineering.
zh: 我的工作围绕分布式存储与基础设施展开，涉及元数据与数据路径、缓存、一致性、故障恢复、RPC、Linux I/O、网络及性能优化。

en: I am especially interested in systems that sit close to AI workloads, where storage, networking, memory hierarchy, and GPU utilization interact in ways that make traditional infrastructure assumptions less useful.
zh: 我尤其关注服务于 AI 工作负载的系统。在这些系统中，存储、网络、内存层次结构与 GPU 利用率相互影响，需要重新审视传统基础设施的设计假设。

en: , accepted at the ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference (ATC 2026), with collaborators at USTC and ByteDance.
zh: ，与中国科学技术大学和字节跳动的合作者共同完成，论文已被 ACM SIGOPS 年度技术会议（ATC 2026）接收。

en: I like working from first principles. For me, understanding a system means being able to explain why its architecture exists, where the trade-offs come from, what fails under pressure, and how those decisions show up in production performance.
zh: 我喜欢从第一性原理出发思考。对我而言，理解一个系统意味着能够解释它为何采用这样的架构、取舍从何而来、在压力下哪些环节会失效，以及这些决策如何影响生产环境中的性能。

en: I use this site to keep a public record of that work: technical notes, deeper essays, project summaries, and things I have learned while building systems.
zh: 我通过这个网站记录工作中的思考，包括技术笔记、深入分析、项目总结，以及构建系统过程中的收获。

en: I work on storage systems where metadata scalability, data placement, consistency, failure recovery, caching, and end-to-end I/O performance all matter at the same time.
zh: 我参与的存储系统需要同时考虑元数据扩展能力、数据放置、一致性、故障恢复、缓存及端到端 I/O 性能。

en: distributed file systems, metadata/data plane design, cache architecture, reliability, C++ and Linux performance.
zh: 分布式文件系统、元数据与数据平面设计、缓存架构、可靠性、C++ 与 Linux 性能优化。

en: I am interested in storage infrastructure for AI workloads: feeding GPU clusters efficiently, reducing avoidable data movement, and designing cache and I/O paths around modern training and inference systems.
zh: 我关注服务于 AI 工作负载的存储基础设施：高效地为 GPU 集群提供数据、减少不必要的数据搬移，以及为现代训练与推理系统设计缓存和 I/O 路径。

en: high-throughput access, cache admission and eviction, prefetching, failure handling, GPU-cluster storage paths.
zh: 高吞吐数据访问、缓存准入与淘汰、预取、故障处理、GPU 集群存储路径。

en: A large part of my work is understanding the details below distributed systems: Linux I/O, concurrency primitives, RPC behavior, networking, RDMA, NVMe, profiling, and latency/throughput trade-offs.
zh: 我的工作很大一部分是深入理解分布式系统的底层细节，包括 Linux I/O、并发原语、RPC 行为、网络、RDMA、NVMe、性能分析，以及延迟与吞吐量之间的取舍。

en: Linux, C++, concurrency, RPC, RDMA, NVMe, performance analysis.
